Read counters only within one epoch. No simultaneous benchmark or build in browser comparison.

before.notes: Real VideoSuperRes + NVENC over Bun loopback WebSocket. Excludes the browser and physical A/V sync; not a browser FPS claim.

after.notes: Real VideoSuperRes + NVENC over Bun loopback WebSocket. Excludes the browser and physical A/V sync; not a browser FPS claim.

limits: Short synthetic trials on one desktop with other desktop applications present; no controlled upstream Python comparison.
The 21 FPS Playwright/pipe baseline used a different browser launch mode; it is not used to calculate this speedup.
Native transport is one before/after pair, 180 frames, discarding first 30, two outstanding inputs and a different deterministic NV12 ramp. It excludes browser capture/decode/presentation.
Dropped counts cover decoded pictures; source callback skips and browser playback-quality counters were not captured in the CDP comparison.
No new independent Media decoder trace, physical scanout or audible synchronization measurement, CPU/RSS/whole-browser VRAM sampling, long-run or 8K throughput validation.
Chromium 148 software/RGBA 1080p-to-4K control stalled and is not a successful throughput result. Its 360p-to-720p GPU lifecycle test passed.
Final timestamp-ordering guard was added after these samples; it is covered by separate regression and GPU/browser checks.
